# WildCat Studios

> Small puzzle and arcade games and calm everyday apps for Android and iOS. Contact: canalbayrak.games@gmail.com

## Games

- [Tilt Grid](https://can-albayrak.github.io/tilt-grid/): A gravity block puzzle: rotate the whole board so blocks fall, lines clear and chains grow. Short offline sessions. Status: live. Package: com.tiltgrid.can.
- [Fuse Chain](https://can-albayrak.github.io/fuse-chain/): A hex puzzle with a fuse: draw a path through gems, light it and set off a chain reaction. Short levels, plays offline. Status: live. Package: com.wildcatstudios.fusechain.
- [Triangle](https://can-albayrak.github.io/triangle/): Complete lines and find triangles in 233 minimalist logic puzzles. Status: live. Package: com.canalbayrak.triangle.
- [Cuddle Pop](https://can-albayrak.github.io/cuddle-pop/): Gentle tap-and-pop games for toddlers: big shapes, soft sounds, no reading needed. Made for parents of 1-4 year olds. Status: in development. Package: com.cuddlepop.kids.
- [SpiderBot: Neon Run](https://can-albayrak.github.io/spiderbot-neon-run/): A neon rooftop runner: a spider robot swings, climbs and parkours across a cyberpunk city. Status: closed test. Package: com.spiderbot.neon.
- [Grovly](https://can-albayrak.github.io/grovly/): A private tracker for nail biting, skin picking and hair pulling: log an urge in two taps, see your patterns and grow a small world on good days. Status: in development. Package: com.wildcat.grovly.
- [Sold! Soccer Squad Builder](https://can-albayrak.github.io/team-deal-versus/): A two-player football auction: bid on real footballers with the same budget, build a squad for the challenge and let real career stats decide the winner. Status: in development. Package: com.wildcat.kadro.
- [Project Cauldron](https://can-albayrak.github.io/project-cauldron/): A color shooter puzzle with slimes: send them around the belt to blast matching cubes and reveal the pixel picture underneath. Status: closed test prep. Package: com.wildcatstudios.cauldron.
